text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create art, compose music, and even write stories or articles. These programs learn from huge amounts of data and then produce something new. However, there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. Humans create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. A machine simply follows patterns it has learned, without really understanding what it makes. So while AI can be a helpful tool and can inspire artists, it cannot replace the human soul behind real art.
